Dear Panickers Travels Team,

I am writing to share my feedback regarding the recently concluded 2 Dham Yatra organized by your team.

While the trip enabled us to complete the pilgrimage, there were several areas where the overall experience fell short of expectations and could be significantly improved for future travelers.

One of the major concerns was the lack of proper guidance regarding the availability of darshan tickets and special darshan options at Kedarnath and Badrinath. As many pilgrims rely on tour operators for such important information, more proactive communication would have been greatly appreciated. The expectation was not necessarily that these arrangements be included in the tour package, but that the available options, costs, and booking procedures be clearly communicated to travelers, allowing them to make informed decisions. Having already invested a significant amount in planning and undertaking this pilgrimage, many of us would have gladly incurred the additional expense for a more convenient and seamless darshan experience had we been made aware of the available options in advance.

Similarly, there was no adequate support or guidance regarding helicopter services to Kedarnath. Considering that many pilgrims, including senior citizens, may prefer this option to ease the journey and facilitate darshan, assistance in understanding availability, booking procedures, and timelines would have been highly beneficial.

Another area of concern was the management of breaks during the long bus journeys. The frequency and duration of stoppages did not sufficiently consider the needs of female travelers, senior citizens, and children. More regular and planned breaks would have made the travel experience much more comfortable.

Food arrangements were another significant area of concern. Both lunch and dinner were frequently served at highly irregular times, causing considerable inconvenience to travelers. There were instances where lunch was provided only during the evening hours, while dinner was delayed until late at night or even around midnight. Such delays were particularly challenging for children, senior citizens, and individuals with medical or dietary requirements. While traffic disruptions and road conditions in the region are understandable, better contingency planning was expected. If substantial delays were anticipated, meals could have been arranged at suitable alternate locations en route rather than waiting to reach the designated hotel. Ensuring timely access to food should be a key priority, especially on long and demanding pilgrimage journeys.

Having said that, I would also like to acknowledge the positive aspects of the trip. The overall schedule was maintained reasonably well despite the challenging travel conditions, and the support staff were courteous, helpful, and respectful throughout the journey.

I hope this feedback is taken constructively and helps improve the experience for future pilgrims. Better planning, communication, and consideration for the comfort of travelers would greatly enhance the quality of the tour.

Thank you for taking the time to review this feedback.

Thanks and Regards,
Kishore Hariharan

Dear Kishore,

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback regarding your recent 2 Dham Yatra.

We sincerely appreciate your constructive insights, as they help us continually improve our services.

Please find our updates and clarifications regarding the points you raised:

1) Darshan Tickets & Guidance: This is an excellent suggestion. We are pleased to inform you that we are currently working on integrating proactive guidance and assistance for darshan tickets, and we plan to introduce this feature very shortly for future travelers. Thank you for this valuable suggestion.

2) Booking Costs & Procedures: We always strive for complete transparency. Our team ensures that all costs, options, and booking procedures are clearly communicated to our customers prior to the journey.

3) Kedarnath Helicopter Services: Due to official regulations, helicopter tickets must be booked directly by travelers through the official IRCTC website. We always inform this to the customers clearly during the booking process and it is also clearly mentioned in our brochure so everyone can make timely arrangements.

4) Journey Breaks & Traffic: We understand how important regular stops are, especially for senior citizens, women, and children. While we always plan and provide timely breaks, severe and unpredictable traffic blocks on these mountainous routes can occasionally disrupt the schedule. Please rest assured that our drivers and staff do their absolute best to manage stops safely and timely under the circumstances.

5) Food Arrangements & Timings: Our priority is the health and safety of our pilgrims, which is why we only partner with quality, hygienic hotels. We arrange regular routes and regular timing for hygiene hotels, but traffic delays affect the time sometimes. Traffic is entirely beyond our control, but we provide other solutions if the condition is worse. We strictly avoid stopping at unhygienic roadside dhabas to ensure our guests do not face health issues during the sacred journey.

Warm regards,
The Panickers Travels Team
